name: Transient Progressive Photon Beams
definition: A volumetric light transport simulation method that uses photon beams to estimate transient radiance, optimizing convergence by minimizing the Asymptotic Mean Squared Error (AMSE) through specific parameter choices for iteration count scaling ($\alpha$) and kernel bandwidth decay ($\beta_T$).
summary: Transient Progressive Photon Beams is a volumetric light transport method that estimates transient radiance in participating media by optimizing kernel decay rates to minimize error and achieve faster convergence than standard progressive methods.
